name: claude-cache
description: Compacts an idle Claude Code session while its prompt cache is warm, with an AFK mode, a handoff note, and a cache TTL countdown in the status line and above the prompt.

autoCompactDefault.title: Auto-compact new sessions
autoCompactDefault.description: Idle auto-compact setting for each new session. Change one session with /cache on, /cache off or the band's Auto button.

compactAfterMinutes.title: Compact after idle minutes
compactAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after the last model request before an idle session compacts. Applies to the 1-hour cache, capped at the TTL minus 2 minutes.

minContextPercent.title: Minimum context for auto-compact (%)
minContextPercent.description: Idle and AFK compaction wait until the context fills this share of the model's window. Smaller compactions save too little. /cache compact ignores this floor.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto reads the TTL from the transcript and environment. 1h or 5m forces one.

showBand.title: Show the cache band above the prompt
showBand.description: The row with the countdown and the Auto, AFK and Compact now buttons, in the terminal and the desktop Code tab.

showStatus.title: Show the cache countdown in the status line
showStatus.description: A short entry such as "cache 42m left · 180k · auto".
